The task has definite output requirements and a correct answer that can be verified, matching Willet's preference profile for structured tasks with unambiguous completion conditions.

Willet self-reports strong preference for structured tasks with definite endpoints like this, as opposed to open-ended creative generation. The modest creative element (choosing numbers) doesn't shift this out of the well-specified category.
